steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: FM Towns Japan Queen of Duellist Rev A HME166A own10-trackdisc plus your own font ROM. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: fmtownskit own-disc EXP/TBIOS recompile, CMake build/rt/tqod. These are manual setup instructions. Portcove does not manage this download or confirm setup or gameplay.
